content.json:
# Coffee roast API operations
Structured application logs, HTTP status/latency and camera rejection events.

content.query: ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL | extend e=parse_json(Log_s) | where tostring(e.event)=="http_request" | summarize Requests=count() by Status=tostring(e.status), bin(TimeGenerated, 1m)
content.title: Request volume and status

content.query: ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL | extend e=parse_json(Log_s) | where tostring(e.event)=="http_request" and tostring(e.path)=="/predict" | summarize p50=percentile(todouble(e.latency_ms),50), p95=percentile(todouble(e.latency_ms),95), p99=percentile(todouble(e.latency_ms),99) by bin(TimeGenerated,1m)
content.title: HTTP latency p50/p95/p99

content.query: ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL | extend e=parse_json(Log_s) | where tostring(e.event)=="occlusion_guard_rejection" | project TimeGenerated, ContainerAppName_s, PixelStd=todouble(e.pixel_std), Entropy=todouble(e.entropy)
content.title: Camera occlusion
